title: Three-Router Distribution
summary: A 120 Mbps stream is distributed across three router paths with two measured differences.
concept: With three unknowns we need three independent equations. Full column rank means exactly one traffic distribution satisfies all constraints.
teachingNotes: A zero in the coefficient matrix means that link does not appear in that particular equation.
Three independent constraints for three unknowns produce a unique solution vector.
Compare this system with the incident case where one equation is a multiple of another.
